# Steam — Naxyň's Polish localization package

- Original source: [Steam — Naxyň's Polish localization package](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009175775)
- Author / publication: Naxyň / Steam Community
- Language / date: Polish; posted 2020-02-28, updated 2024-12-07
- Access: Guide body and visible comment excerpt inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Naxyň says the package reuses the Polish edition's dubbing, dialogue, subtitles with diacritics, and opening and closing videos. Installation instructions are inside an external archive that was not inspected.

A separate performance package is described as restoring the CD edition's font as well. A visible reader comment reports working voices but missing Polish characters, showing that successful audio replacement does not necessarily imply correct text rendering.

This documents a community package and reported symptoms, not a verified localization installation. No game assets were downloaded or copied into the repository.
